Grand Opening, Happy Hour and a FULL house!! We met up with some friends for a total of 6 of us, including two kids. We sat inside because we arrived before the rush and once that happened there were too many of us to grab a seat outside. Inside was air conditioned, and the atmosphere was fun. Service was great and we enjoyed ourselves. Outside was fun as well with live music and rooftop access. We ordered drinks from the rooftop bar and the bartenders were fast and friendly. We sampled The Crowley, Swamp Donkey and The Elder Bull. Elder Bull was my favorite as the others were a bit too sweet for my taste. Had the chance to attend the grand opening of The Banks Drinkery and Kitchen thanks to Yelp, and I enjoyed every second of the experience. I tried the Treme Pasta which was nothing short of flavorful, the Southwest Rolls were delectable and the chargrilled oysters would land a spot on my top 5 best chargrilled oysters. They also had an open patio and rooftop bar which was the perfect setting for a summer evening. And what's a summer evening without one of their Summer Original cocktails. I had the Crowley and The Elder Bull. Both had a kick but also a sweet flavor which was right up my alley. I'll definitely be spreading the word about this new spot and I'm anxious to go back!
